title: WhatsApp patches file spoofing (CVE-2026-23863) and arbitrary URL scheme (CVE-2026-23866) vulnerabilities

CVE-2026-23863.evidence: from arbitrary URLs, including custom URL scheme handlers (`facetime:`, `tel:`, `itms-apps:`). While neither vulnerability has evidence of in-the-wild exploitation, the URL scheme flaw could enable phishing redirection. Users should update WhatsApp to the latest version.

CVE-2026-23866.evidence: from arbitrary URLs, including custom URL scheme handlers (`facetime:`, `tel:`, `itms-apps:`). While neither vulnerability has evidence of in-the-wild exploitation, the URL scheme flaw could enable phishing redirection. Users should update WhatsApp to the latest version.
